{"notes": "VISIT 1 (ended 1:00): Priya took charge, set the body plan and split the work into top line, bottom line and fin/tail. She handled the Tom overlap well at 0:45, though her first split was changed within 30 seconds. Tom was agreeable. Maya and Leo were silent.

VISIT 2 (ended 2:30). Picture: both dark body lines now run most of the way across. The top ends near (23, 8) and the bottom near (25, 10). The nose is NOT joined, with a gap of about 2 units. The top line looks doubled near the tail (two parallel strands around x 9-12). The fin (pale) is NOT connected to the start, so it is not attached to the top line yet. No tail lobes are visible. I can't tell who placed what, so I'm not crediting anyone for the build itself.

Tom: Took the fin (stroke four) from Leo and said he'd check the joint with the top line, and stay clear of Priya's end. He communicated clearly, but the fin is detached right now, so his check matters. Follow up on it.

Leo: Spoke up this time. He coordinated the stroke numbering, handed the fin to Tom and took both tail lobes (five and six). Good collaboration, but no tail is visible after 2.5 minutes. Ask him for progress.

Priya: Not seen or heard this visit. I can't rate her leadership update. Ask whether the nose join is owned by anyone.

Maya: Still silent and not visible in my notes. No evidence of impact yet. Ask her directly what she is working on.

NEXT: Check nose join, fin attachment, tail built, and whether Priya and Maya contribute."}
